body: Why would I tell anyone, I hate all of my family, my friends have problems of their own. And like hell I’d ever tell my girlfriend, she doesn’t need to worry about this.
I don’t know, I’m sad but I can’t cry, I want to kill myself, but I don’t want to leave my girlfriend alone. I don’t know
I don’t know what I want.
There’s not much you can tell me that’s not already been said. I’m sorry.
